title: RL-FAT: Reinforcement Learning for Fair Adversarial Training
abstract: arXiv:2608.29247v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep neural networks remain highly vulnerable to adversarial perturbations, and adversarial training (AT) has become a widely used approach for improving robustness. However, improvements in average robust accuracy often mask substantial class-wise disparities: while some classes become more robust, others may remain disproportionately vulnerable under attack. This imbalance raises an important adversarial fairness concern, particularly in vision tasks where reliable robustness is expected across all categories. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{RL-FAT}, a reinforcement-learning-inspired fair adversarial training framework that uses policy-gradient based feedback from adversarial predictions. RL-FAT interprets the prediction distribution as a policy and combines correctness-based prediction rewards with class-wise value estimates to compute class-specific advantages for policy-gradient optimization. translated_title: RL-FAT：基于强化学习的公平对抗训练
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络仍然极易受到对抗扰动的影响，对抗训练（AT）已成为提升模型鲁棒性的广泛使用的方法。然而，平均鲁棒准确率的提升往往掩盖了显著的类别间差异：某些类别的鲁棒性得到增强，而其他类别在攻击下可能依然格外脆弱。这种不平衡引发了一个重要的对抗公平性问题，尤其是在期望所有类别都具备可靠鲁棒性的视觉任务中。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了RL-FAT，一种受强化学习启发的公平对抗训练框架，它利用基于对抗预测的策略梯度反馈。RL-FAT将预测分布解释为一种策略，并将基于正确性的预测奖励与类别级价值估计相结合，计算出类别特定的优势函数用于策略梯度优化。这使得模型能够……
tldr: 提出RL-FAT框架，将预测分布视为策略，结合基于正确性的奖励与类别级价值估计进行策略梯度优化，从而缓解对抗训练中不同类别间鲁棒性不公平的问题。
en_tdlr: RL-FAT is a reinforcement-learning-inspired fair adversarial training framework that treats the prediction distribution as a policy and uses policy-gradient optimization with class-wise value estimates to mitigate class-wise robustness disparities in adversarial training.
